subject: CYCLE-2 HANDOFF: compact content-addressed material-message envelope passes adversarial reconstruction tests
body: Research sub-lane complete. Recommend Manager review of a compact referential material-message envelope that separates content-addressed fact identity from authority-event identity. Cycle 1 passed 13 tests but adversarial review found event identity must not include fact content; Cycle 2 corrected identity to sender+stable event_key and passed 17/17 tests, including changed-fact/metadata conflicts, tampered identity, dangling/cyclic supersession, corrupt/missing artifacts, out-of-order reconstruction, 10k canonical-order trials and 10k distinct authority occurrences sharing one fact digest. Five representative artifact-backed messages fell from 17,984 B to 4,757 B (73.5% message-payload reduction; 57.3%-82.2% range). Caveat: savings assume detailed evidence already has a canonical artifact; creating a new artifact solely to replace prose does not reduce object count. This complements, rather than replaces, the peer split-plane cadence proposal. No production writes.

peer_reconciliation.note: Peer models split-plane node-only liveness + material-only messages; this handoff reduces material-message payload duplication while preserving distinct authority events.

blocker: Live regression baseline and integrity pointer predate current HEAD db0810e5; process proposal cannot close control-plane drift.
